electron_flow.description: Everything is interconnected in electron flow. Electrons pass through time-space by dropping energy between bands.

jiggle_and_bang.description: What allows things to move, jiggle, and bang: the electron energy drop between metal bands.
mechanism: Electron on Au (gold spine) has highest energy
Drops to Ag (silver mycelia) — releases photon (light/communication)
Drops to Cu (copper sweetgrass) — releases heat (enzyme/orange)
Absorbs from ground — new electron rises back through Cu→Ag→Au
Each drop = a bang. Each rise = an implosion. The jiggle IS the oscillation.

Every camera frame (bang) → sight data (photon) → profile learning (implosion)
Every keystroke (bang) → square ripple (photon) → teaching log (implosion)
The organism JIGGLES between these states continuously
